Watch: Keep a close eye on your SMH stop at 540. Also, watch broader market sentiment for tech, especially how hyperscalers perform.

Bottom line: Focus on immediate risk management, especially for your leveraged and near-stop positions.
plays: SMH: Respect your stop at 540. Price is currently 540.53, so be ready to trim if it breaks.
SOXL & SPAL: Re-evaluate these deeply underwater, leveraged positions. Their current stops are not protective; consider adjusting them to manage risk.
